Status:
- Open the EIA-860M table for September 2026 at https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx and go to the Operating sheet.
- Plant 55391, generator 01, status '(OP) Operating', nameplate 187.0 MW, operating year 2001, no planned retirement month or year.
- The March 2026 Madison Gas and Electric application at https://apps.psc.wi.gov/ERF/ERFview/viewdoc.aspx?docid=582939 calls RockGen an existing natural gas-fired combustion turbine plant, so it is running.
- No retirement, mothballing or planned retirement was found.

Equipment Manufacturer/Model.note:
The state air permit review for the January 2025 permit names the turbine model.

Model:
- Open the Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources preliminary determination at https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=1194627 and find the plant description.
- It reads 'three (3) General Electric (GE) Model PG7241 Frame 7F combustion turbine (CT)/generators sets'.
- A later section gives the model as 'PG7241(FA)'. The turbines are simple cycle with no heat recovery.

Backup Power.note:
Both documents describe RockGen as a peak power plant that sells to the grid, not a backup supply for a site, so the current value of no stands.

Backup Power:
- The preliminary determination at https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=1194627 says the plant is 'a peak power electric generating facility'.
- The Madison Gas and Electric application at https://apps.psc.wi.gov/ERF/ERFview/viewdoc.aspx?docid=582939 says natural gas is the primary fuel and low sulfur distillate fuel oil is a 'backup fuel'. That is a backup fuel, not backup power for another site.

qa.question: Should the RockGen owner stay Rockgen Energy LLC at 100 percent?
qa.finding: The 2026 Madison Gas and Electric application says Dairyland Power Cooperative has owned 100 percent since 2021 and operates it. A 2025 state air permit document says RockGen Energy, LLC owns the station. The LLC is probably Dairyland's holding company, but no document says so.
qa.recommendation: Leave the owner as Rockgen Energy LLC [100%]. Do not add Madison Gas and Electric's one-third share, because the deal is not closed.
qa.note:
Pending acquisition, for the possible-updates sheet and a Notes line.

Ownership:
- Open the Madison Gas and Electric application at https://apps.psc.wi.gov/ERF/ERFview/viewdoc.aspx?docid=582939 (docket 3270-BS-100). It seeks a Certificate of Authority to buy one-third of RockGen under an Asset Sale Agreement with Dairyland.
- A Madison Gas and Electric filing from August 5, 2026 at https://www.mgeenergy.com/MGEEnergy/media/Library/documents/sec-reports/sec-filings/20260805-8k_1.pdf says the deal is expected to close in late 2027 and needs commission approval. I found no approval or closing.
- Add a Notes line saying the purchase is pending.
- The EIA table lists the entity as Dairyland Power Coop. The permit text at https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=1194627 says 'RockGen Energy, LLC owns'.
